description: Escorts Investment Bank Limited is a non-banking finance company licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan to carry out investment finance services, incorporated on 15 May 1995 and in commercial operation since 16 October 1996. It says it has chosen to remain an investment bank within the NBFC structure, with a business plan focused on profitability and sustainable growth through a broader range of products and services, capacity building and risk management. It lends to households and businesses from a head office in Lahore, and its PACRA ratings are BBB long-term and A2 short-term.
headOffice: Ground Floor, 26 Davis Road, Lahore, Pakistan

products.name: Deposits
products.summary: Term investment products with flexible terms of three months to five years, with profit payable at a bank of the customer's choice or at their doorstep.

products.name: Housing finance
products.summary: Home finance for members of Bahria Town for building, purchase or renovation, including construction financing up to 100% of construction cost.

products.name: Micro finance
products.summary: Micro-finance products serving un-served and underserved markets; the bank describes itself as the first investment bank to offer them.

products.name: Corporate and SME financing
products.summary: Business term loans, bill discounting, and trade finance and guarantees.

products.name: Gold finance
products.summary: Gold-backed finance with minimal documentation, no guarantee requirement and flexible terms.
